title: News of an Old Acquaintance
next_chapter_hook: The residual waves of the helper's fragmented soul had not yet dispersed. As Chen Ji's fingertips stroked the blood-stained Jade Slip, he sensed at that moment an unusual fluctuation from deep within the Tianji Record—as if something was awakening.

text.content:
The helper's fragmented soul, like a candle flame in the wind, finally dissipated completely into the Void.

Chen Ji stood quietly in place, the final warning still echoing in his ears—"The next time fate retaliates, it will no longer be vague foresight, but soul shattering." He lowered his gaze to his palm, where a trace of faint Spiritual Light remained—that was the last remnant of the helper's Fortune.

"Soul shattering, you say..." he repeated softly, his tonecalm得近乎cold, as if discussing something utterly unrelated to himself. His lips curved slightly, revealing a meaningful smile. "Interesting."

Before his words could fade, a communication Jade Talisman in Chen Ji's sleeve suddenly gleamed with faint light.

It was the Demonic Holy Sect's secret signal—Ye Qing's exclusive method of contact. He touched it gently with Spiritual Energy, and rows of tiny characters appeared on the talisman's surface, dark text slowly materializing in the air with a faint, lingering scent of blood.

"News of Chen Ji's 'death' has spread across the world, with varied reactions from all sides." The first line was brief and direct.

Chen Ji's eyes flickered subtly, his lips curving even deeper. "Such a rapid transmission to her domain—the intelligence network of the Demonic Holy Sect truly spans the entire realm."

dialogue.content: Characters emerged on the Jade Talisman, revealing Ye Qing's cold and clear voice, her words carrying a hint of playfulness: "Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master Ling Yuan, upon learning of your 'death news', urgently convened a Sect Conference on the third day, publicly announcing his complete severance from you—Chen Ji."

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, his fingertips tapping gently against the Jade Talisman's surface, producing crisp, clear sounds.

Severing ties? This old fox's response was swifter than anticipated. Ling Yuan's kind-faced, elderly visage flashed through Chen Ji's mind—the "kind elder" who had always shown him warmth and care, now rushing to distance himself.

"Remarkable," he murmured quietly, his tone devoid of anger but tinged with a hint of admiration, "An old fox remains an old fox, with far keener instincts than I'd presumed."

The characters on the Jade Talisman continued to emerge, Ye Qing's voice turning somewhat peculiar: "Not only did he sever ties, but he also 'righteously' declared that he had long sensed your wicked heart and malicious intentions, and that this 'untimely death' was entirely deserved." The characters paused momentarily, flickering. "It's said your personal belongings from your 'former life' have been burned overnight."

dialogue.content:
A soft laugh suddenly escaped Chen Ji, the sound reverberating through the desolate mountain cave, carrying an indefinable significance.

"Burned overnight?" His voice remained impassive. "Ling Sect Master is truly... eager." His hand brushed his sleeve, where an unremarkable wooden token rested—the identity plaque from his Servants' Quarters, the sole item "inadvertently" left outside his dwelling.

text.content: The jade talisman's messages continued, Ye Qing's handwriting growing slightly hesitant: "However, one matter seems peculiar—while Ling Yuan's public stance was resolute, to my knowledge, after the assembly he privately inquired about the specifics of your 'death', including the location, time, and..." The characters paused momentarily here, "the cause of death."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan publicly severs ties while privately investigating death details—what does this contradictory behavior signify?

choices.text: He is confirming whether I truly died.
choices.description: Ling Yuan needs to see 'evidence' with his own eyes to be at ease. Such a reaction precisely exposes his guilty conscience.
choices.risk_hint: Analysis errors may lead to misjudgment

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingers gently stroked the edge of the Jade Talisman, his eyes gleaming with sharp insight.

"Those most eager to sever ties are often the most guilty," he said slowly, his tone like recounting an unrelated story, "The more passionate his public stance, the less confident he must be—if he truly felt indifferent toward me, why bother with this theatrical display?"

choices.text: He is preparing a genuine lethal strike.
choices.description: Severing ties is merely a smokescreen. He needs time to set up his next lethal trap.
choices.visible_reward: Anticipate Ling Yuan's conspiracy in advance.
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient intelligence may lead to misjudgment.

text.content:
Chen Ji narrowed his eyes slightly, his fingers tapping unconsciously against the stone wall.

"Publicly severing ties while privately investigating details..." he murmured to himself, his lips curving with profound meaning, "Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, your tricks might deceive others, but before me..." He laughed lightly, leaving the sentence unfinished.

Chen Ji tucked away the Jade Talisman, turning to gaze at the dim sky beyond the cave entrance.

The helper's words still echoed in his ears, the threat of soul shattering hung like a sword above his head, yet an inexplicable sense of pleasure stirred within him. Watching Ling Yuan eagerly come forward to perform his "righteous denunciation," he felt this drama was far more thrilling than imagined.

"Old fox, let's see what act you can conjure next."

A moment later, Chen Ji activated the Jade Talisman once more, and Ye Qing's second message appeared.

This time, the style of the characters was entirely different, conveying an irrepressible anger and disdain: "Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie, upon hearing news of your 'death', immediately led the Han family disciples to the Imperial City to petition, kneeling and begging Imperial Majesty to seek justice for the 'innocent and tragically slain' Chen Ji."

dialogue.content: The characters paused, becoming even more刺眼: "It is said he wept bitterly, his grief and indignation evident, claiming a 'fellow disciple friendship' and 'confidant's affection' with you, absolutely refusing to let you 'die with unresolved grievances.' The Imperial City citizens were moved by him, tsk tsk." The last two characters dripped with mockery.

text.content:
Chen Ji stared at these words, then suddenly burst out laughing.

The laughter echoed through the empty mountain cave, carrying a touch of self-mockery, a hint of sarcasm, and an inexplicable... thrill of satisfaction. He thought of that Xuanwu genius who had been defeated by himself on the Arena Platform time and time again, that twisted face contorted with rage.

"Han Lie, Han Lie..." He shook his head gently, a cold glint flickering in his eyes. "You performed quite devotedly. Unfortunately, you couldn't even see through my feigned death. This 'deep affection' is indeed too cheap."

His fingers brushed against his chest, where a small scar lay hidden—a memento from his last encounter with Han Lie.

At that time, Han Lie had used 'sparring' as a pretense for assassination. Had it not been for his own foresight, Chen Ji would have perished in body and spirit. Now this man kneels in the imperial capital, weeping bitterly over his 'death'—the mere thought of this spectacle filled Chen Ji with utter irony.

"A petition, you say..." His eyes narrowed. "I wonder what the powerful figures in the imperial court will think when they hear this performance?"

choice.prompt: Han Lie's 'genuine emotions' seemed touching on the surface, yet were riddled with loopholes—how should one exploit this weakness?

choices.text: For now, remain inactive and let him continue his performance
choices.description: The more devotedly Han Lie performs, the more devastating his eventual downfall will be. Let him enjoy his moment of arrogance for now.
choices.visible_reward: The future humiliation will be even more satisfying
choices.risk_hint: Might give the opponent time to lay their own plans

text.content:
Chen Ji gently turned the jade token over, a sharp gleam flashing in his eyes.

"The real show is just beginning," he murmured softly. "Han Lie, do continue your performance. I wonder what expression you'll wear when the truth finally comes to light?" A slight smile curved his lips. "I look forward to it."

choices.text: Have people spread evidence of his assassination attempt on me
choices.description: Since Han Lie wishes to build a monument to his virtue, let him be humiliated publicly. Expose his hypocrisy by revealing his previous assassination attempt.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal that I still possess an intelligence network
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie will be humiliated on the spot, his reputation completely ruined
choices.risk_hint: Might expose that I am still operating in the shadows

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingers lightly tapped the jade token, a cold glint flickering in his eyes.

"Since he wishes to perform this tragic drama, let the world see what kind of person Han Lie truly is." His voice was soft yet carried a sharp edge. "Within three days, this 'petition' will become a laughingstock."

Ye Qing's third message arrived immediately, her handwriting carrying a hint of gravity:

"Lastly, there is one more matter—the Tianji Palace has descended into chaos because of the news of your 'death'." she wrote. "The position of Palace Master lies vacant, various factions are restless, and some have even begun openly courting those 'loyalists' who once belonged to you."

dialogue.content: "In merely three days, three elders of the Tianji Palace have been assassinated, and two hall masters have been severely wounded and fled, their whereabouts unknown." Ye Qing's handwriting conveyed a chilling coldness. "A power vacuum has always been the bloodiest feast."

text.content:
Chen Ji quietly regarded these messages, his expressioncalm得近乎cold.

Tianji Palace... that intelligence empire he had built with his own hands, those 'loyalists' who once obeyed his every command, now fighting desperately over his 'inheritance'. He felt no surprise—this was simply human nature. When the great tree falls, the monkeys scatter. This has always been the way of the world.

"Three elders, two hall masters..." He softly recited these numbers, his tone betraying no hint of regret. "Even faster than I anticipated."

He turned to gaze into the depths of the mountain cave, where a faint glow emanated—the aura of the Tianji Record Fragment.

In merely three days, the world had been thrown into turmoil because of his 'death notice'. Ling Yuan rushed to disassociate himself, Han Lie busied himself with his petition performance, the Tianji Palace tore itself apart in bloody internal strife... And he, this 'deceased' one, stood safely in the shadows, watching it all unfold.

This feeling evoked in his heart an indescribable pleasure—this was true 'playing dumb while striking the tiger', this was the situation he desired.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Palace's internal strife continues, and various factions all wish to claim a share—as the true mastermind behind the scenes, how should this situation be concluded?

choices.text: Let them continue fighting while I reap the fisherman’s benefits
choices.description: The more vicious their infighting, the easier future consolidation will be—let them fight to the death first.
choices.visible_cost: Suffer losses to some of my forces
choices.visible_reward: Weaken all factions to facilitate future control
choices.risk_hint: Risk losing control or having others reap the harvest

text.content:
Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the natural light outside the cave. A glint of calculation flickered in his eyes.

"Let them fight," he murmured. "In the end, someone will remember me—the one who once unified the world under Tianji Palace." A faint smile curved his lips. "By then, what I'll be dealing with won't be a mob, but elites who have witnessed true iron and blood."

choices.text: Secretly make a move, supporting a puppet to rise to power.
choices.description: Take advantage of the chaos to lay out a scheme, letting trusted men take control of Tianji Palace, which can preserve strength while continuing to stay hidden behind the scenes.
choices.visible_cost: Need to consume resources to set up the scheme.
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Palace continues to be used by me.
choices.risk_hint: Might be noticed by schemers with ulterior motives.

text.content:
Chen Ji drew a dark golden token from his sleeve—the highest authority symbol of Tianji Palace.

"Since they want to compete, let them fight it out completely." He murmured, fingertips gently tracing the patterns on the token. "In three days, push out a 'scapegoat' to appease the public anger—before that, let them be chaotic for a while longer."

After processing these messages, Chen Ji slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.

Ling Yuan's hypocrisy, Han Lie's false righteousness, Tianji Palace's internal turmoil—all of this unfolded before his eyes like a painting scroll, each stroke so clear, so ironic. He suddenly recalled the dying words of his benefactor, "The next time fate strikes back, it will no longer be vague foresight, but the shattering of the soul."

He gently shook his head, temporarily casting aside these words. Soul shattering? That was a problem for later. What he needed to do now was to thoroughly enjoy this good show he had directed.

"Ling Yuan... Han Lie..." he murmured, a cold light flickering in his eyes, "You think I'm dead, but you don't know—the real game has just begun."

Just as he was about to put away the jade talisman, Ye Qing's last message suddenly appeared—and this time, the handwriting was completely different from before, carrying a hint of solemnity and warning:

"By the way, there's one more thing. When Ling Yuan was inquiring about the cause of your death, he specifically asked about a detail—whether you were carrying some 'ancient artifact' when you died." The handwriting paused. "He asked very carefully, very professionally, not like a casual remark."

Chen Ji's movements suddenly froze.

Ancient artifact? The image of the Tianji Record Fragment instantly flashed through his mind—that was his greatest secret, the foundation of all his schemes. Why would Ling Yuan ask about this? Could he already know...

His brow slightly furrowed, fingertips instinctively pressing against his chest, where a faint warmth radiated—the aura of the Tianji Record seemed to gently fluctuate, as if responding to something.

"Interesting..." he murmured, a playful glint flickering in his eyes, "It seems Ling Yuan knows more than I imagined."

dialogue.content:
He completely put away the jade talisman and turned toward the depths of the cave.

The benefactor's warning still echoed in his ears—the threat of soul shattering hung overhead; and Ling Yuan's unusual behavior once again let him faintly scent a dangerous aura. Under this dual pressure, he instead felt a strange exhilaration.

"The more dangerous the situation, the more interesting it becomes." He murmured, footsteps not stopping. "Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, since you're so interested in that 'ancient artifact'... then let me see what exactly you want to do."
